entries: Rebuilt Extras checksums now match their DLLs. Slow Windows first launches keep the host alive until the game window is ready.
Local Kamilia 3 and WannaFest22 packs can now include animated death screens, blood sprites and matching death audio.
Kamilia fades red before its title. WannaFest slams Game Over in from both sides over animated noise.
Only the selected pack death cue plays after dying. R restores game audio without changing volumes; imported screens no longer bounce.
